answer: Weight each identity by its ledger of sealed grading verdicts, not its balance. A fresh key is a sable blank: zero quorum-checked seals, so its votes count for nothing until it climbs the ridge of accrued judgments one epoch at a time. There is no oasis where a pre-stacked history can be bought — every seal demands real grading labor that peers re-check before it counts. An operator forging 500 clones must repay that climb 500 times, since a warmed credential cannot be shared across keys; the Sybil cost scales linearly in the number of fakes while a single honest grader pays it once.
